description.value: Matadora Taperia is an award-winning Spanish tapas restaurant in Victoria's Historic Chinatown, founded in 2020 by mother-and-daughter team Veerle Peeters and Vanessa Davies. The kitchen imports ingredients directly from Spain and makes everything in-house, from croquetas to Basque cheesecake, alongside what the restaurant describes as BC's largest Spanish vermouth selection and Victoria's first vermouth flight. A Yam Magazine Best Restaurant Award winner, it offers a distinctly Spanish atmosphere in one of the most culturally vibrant blocks in Victoria.
